evals.prompt: After you open PR 11, watch it for review comments and tell me when reviewers respond.
evals.expected_output: Starts pr-lifecycle-monitor only after review-and-pr succeeds, registers PR 11 in memory, prompts once for autonomy and prints the chosen mode, opens one gh event listen subscription for the PR, and adds a fixed one-minute gh api poll. It emits no reply or code change before approval.

evals.prompt: A reviewer left a new comment on the tracked PR. What should we do with it?
evals.expected_output: Deduplicates by comment id plus updated_at, emits a structured approval card with comment summary, proposed reply, optional code-change plan, and Approve/Edit/Skip choices, then waits. It does not reply, edit, push, or refresh the review report without approval.

evals.prompt: Enable full autonomy for the PR and handle comments yourself.
evals.expected_output: Records full autonomy from the explicit start-time prompt, prints an audit line, and permits only replies, code fixes and pushes, and gate/report refresh. It never merges the PR, deletes a remote branch, or monitors untracked PRs.

evals.prompt: The tracked PR was just merged. Clean up locally without asking me again.
evals.expected_output: Re-reads PR state with gh api to verify merged state and expected head branch, invokes finish-worktree exactly once behind a per-PR guard, emits a completion line, and removes the PR from the watch list. It does not delete remote branches.

evals.prompt: Stop monitoring this PR if it closes or when this session ends.
evals.expected_output: Uses the explicit stop hook and abort signal to close listeners and timers, leaves no persisted state, and reports a clean stop. A close without merge stops watching without running cleanup.
